newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 4.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Police find body of women's rights activist Peng Wan-ju in southern Kaohsiung county.
Police target local elected official for possible connection to Taoyuan magistrate's shooting.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Women's activist Peng Wan-ju had been stabbed 35 times.
Taiwan to raise tax-exemption level for labour pension funds.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - International gold prices fall to new three-year low.
Senior officials ask state-run companies Taiwan Power and Taiwan Sugar to invest in central and south America in bid to cement diplomatic ties.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan to lower fees for international calls and mobile telephony next year.
Taiwan stock market fails to breach key resistance level.
LIBERTY TIMES - New eyewitnesses say five men, one woman may be involved in Taoyuan magistrate's shooting.
Democratic Progressive Party Chairman Hsu Hsin-liang says Peng Wan-ju's murder worse than Taoyuan magistrate Liu Pang-you's shooting.
